evidenceCommit: Exact evidence-only commit is the Git commit containing this report; returned after push, never a self-referential SHA.

originalIntermediateProducer.operation: Writes draft plus postGenerationInterpretation, bounded safety-tradeoff label, eight additionalEvidence links and pre-evidence GitHub receipt; JSON.stringify(...,null,2)+LF. Receipt SHA is this intermediate state, not the final report.

subsequentOperations.operation: Append scope clarification, scope-proof link, interpretation link and12knownEvidenceLimitations; serialize pretty JSON+LF
Append post_run_asset_verification receipt at additionalEvidence[8]; serialize pretty JSON+LF; recompute evidence manifest

r1Reconciliation.sourceAvailability: The intermediate producer is versioned verbatim in generatorSource. Subsequent read-only report packaging commands are in the prior conversation tool history, not separate retained executable files. Their exact data operations are losslessly reconstructed here; both endpoint byte hashes match. No claim that an unretained intermediate file was independently archived.

semanticJsonDiff.value: Historical XC2 REPORTS unchanged. Existing research xc2_product_metrics.mjs gained only an optional replay injection; default original replay/oracle untouched, 35Node+3Docker tests passed. Production ledger/projector and all customer-web implementation files unchanged.

value: Replay uses already-seen XC2 DEVELOPMENT/EVALUATION; diagnostic only, no fresh winner.
Bounded closed-WRONG priority can preempt observations from open future expected matches. Substantial missing/incomplete detection tradeoff; not a production-ledger migration.
Conditional correct-class latency percentiles have changing denominators; paired fixed-target distributions separately retained.
Three28-second clips, three sessions/config; no indefinite-runtime, device capture, AudioWorklet, UI/render/perceptual or thermal-cause proof.
No contemporaneous original/new harness A/B; pure ORT variation is not explained by persistence removal.
Configuration positions globally balanced, but order within a particular clip is not independently randomized.
Ten of1269 browser timers fired sub-millisecond early (minimum -0.434726ms); raw source-time scheduling rows retained, no hard sample-clock causal deadline claim.
Streaming FIR reference/chunk parity covers frozen fixtures and three real guarded PCM clips; not arbitrary hardware capture-clock drift qualification.
LINEAR runtime assumes pre-existing canonical16k PCM; no new browser-linear stereo microphone front-end qualification.
Historical same-pitch and all-group component counts are scenario-expanded, not independent statistical replicates.
XC2 expected score times derived from physical MIDI, so no natural early/late timing external validity.
Empty GitHub status/workflow arrays are not CI PASS.

r1Reconciliation.interpretation: Provenance receipt captured an intermediate report hash, while manifest captured the later final packaging state. This is a reporting-chain omission, not a scientific-policy or measurement change.

parameterProvenance.r2Study: w250ms remains unchanged. Only finalization semantics vary; no decoder/resampler/ORT/model/profile sweep and no new neural inference.

mathematicalHorizon.expected: w250; legal observation o in[t-w,t+w]. Direct same-pitch competitor u requires|u-t|<=2w. H(t)=max(u+w) over literal direct cohort, so H(t)<=t+3w=t+750. Never use H(u) to expand H(t).
mathematicalHorizon.commit: Anchors whose own H is covered are processed in performance-time/ID order. Optimize only pending members of the anchors literal one-hop cohort and all their available legal observations. Stable sorted IDs for matching ties. Commit the anchor only; future proposals remain provisional.
mathematicalHorizon.wrong: Local group spans[a,b], Delta=b-a<=20ms in this corpus. Candidate incompatible observation o in[a-w,a+w] has direct correct claimant u<=o+w<=a+2w; its legal window closes u+w<=a+3w. G(g)=max(b+w, own strikes H, all such claimant local closes)<=b+3w=a+750+Delta<=a+770.
mathematicalHorizon.conservativeGroupCoverage: G includes all locally incompatible observations, even already-consumed ones, making the post-local-coverage horizon fixed and auditable. It does not follow any competitors competitors.
mathematicalHorizon.reservation: Any residual observation with an uncommitted directly legal expected strike remains RESERVED, never WRONG. At G, a group may finalize MISSING/INCOMPLETE while such evidence stays reserved; this never prolongs G to a claimants own later H. No retroactive repair after commitment.
mathematicalHorizon.extra: An observation o can match expected t<=o+w; H(t)<=t+3w<=o+4w. A directly legal incompatible group has a<=o+w and b<=a+Delta; G(g)<=b+3w<=o+4w+Delta. E(o)=max(o, directly legal expected H, directly legal WRONG-group G)<=o+1000+Delta<=o+1020. Fixed composition of direct queries, not transitive closure.
mathematicalHorizon.terminal: Explicit natural scope completion clamps horizons to the declared end; manual incomplete strikes NOT_REACHED. Terminal witnesses retain unclamped horizon and clamp flag.

conclusionRule.oracle: Immutable original XC2 oracle labels and original eligible scenarios; never revalidate/relabel with R2.
conclusionRule.r1: Reproduce frozen R1 only to compare its exact verdict digest with its immutable archived witness stream; preserve published R1 counts and disposition.
conclusionRule.latency: Sealed publication availability clocks unchanged; policy replay latency only, no new inference/runtime/UI measurements.
conclusionRule.assignmentSignature: low-level verdict plus matchedObservationId; all disagreements retain causal strike witnesses.
conclusionRule.fullRecoveryConclusion: Requires all baseline9MISSING->WRONG and4INCOMPLETE->WRONG cases recovered, every original-correct/R1-incorrect target recovered in all tested cells, no newly regressed target vs R1 or original, no increase in any critical false-accept count, and all ownership/horizon audits pass. Pre-existing acoustic errors need not vanish; no equivalence claim.
conclusionRule.partialRecoveryConclusion: If any of baseline13wrong-preemption errors recovers but full criteria fail and critical false-accept counts do not increase: PARTIALLY_RECOVERS_SAFETY. Otherwise STILL_HAS_MATERIAL_SAFETY_TRADEOFF. No non-inferiority margin or winner.

criticalInterpretation: Observed recovery is not mathematical policy equivalence or a fresh evaluation. Pre-existing acoustic mistakes remain visible. No production migration or winner.
limitations: Both splits already seen, counterfactual times derived from physical MIDI, not independent natural score-clock timing.
One-hop conditional reservation is intentionally not transitive offline optimization. Reserved evidence can outlive a group without reopening it.
Latency reuses original research-harness availability; no new neural, browser/runtime, device, UI or perceptual measurement.
Original class-conditional latency percentiles may change denominator; per-target cases also retain the same fixed truth target and availability timestamps.
EXTRA target failures have audit references to the scenario snapshot; missing detection is not assigned zero latency.
No profile optimization; current representative is selected by non-performance neutral hash, not an empirical optimum.
